text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With the Tenno Sho (Spring) right around the corner, Tokai Teio was putting even more passion into her training.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whew... *sigh*.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, how was that?
Pretty good time, wasn't it!?
choice_data_list: Let's keep this momentum going and win the race too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! I'll prove that I'm still top-class
in the Senior Year too!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you're working hard, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah! Prezzz!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Not much longer until the Tenno Sho.
How are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Of course I'm in top condition!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Now that I'm officially in the Senior Class,
I can't afford any sloppy races, so I'm giving it my all!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Pushing steadily forward,
it seems you are striving hard toward your goal.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now that you've run your way through the Classic year,
I can't wait to see what kind of race you'll show us next.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh!
Try not to be too amazed, okay!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, what's that?
That crowd of people."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...I am terribly sorry, but
we are currently in the middle of training.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Just a comment on your enthusiasm
for the Tenno Sho will be plenty!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: At least keep your current condition!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I will speak on the matter at the press conference later, so please excuse me for now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...I need to push myself even harder...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Ah!? McQueen-sa~n!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The press, huh... I must caution them not to disrupt training.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I don't see why they can't just do a simple interview.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"No... In the past, she would have at least
agreed to a brief interview."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However, that is no longer the case now...
It means a major change has occurred within her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Teio, with the way she is now,
it won't be easy to win against her.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I mean, I know McQueen is strong, but...
Still...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
“Still, we're both training with everything we've got!
I'm doing my best too, you know!”

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I'll show the Prez right now!
Watch me run in top form!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Here I go~...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yaaa~~h!!!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ..."The same," huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A press conference was held for the Umamusume running in the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
There are high expectations for you in the Senior Year as well.
How do you feel about that?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"The feeling that I'll definitely win!
The Teio Legend will keep on going in the Senior Class too!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"Among the opposition is the equally spotlighted
Mejiro McQueen, however."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry! Right now, I'm in
the best shape I've ever been in!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I don't feel like I could lose to anyone—
I feel like I could just run to the ends of the earth!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Ooh, full of confidence, aren't we~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next, Mejiro McQueen's press conference
began.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: How are you feeling heading into the Spring Tenno Sho?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I am doing my utmost
to prevent an undesirable outcome.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I must secure victory...
That is the resolve with which I approach this.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
You seemed to be putting a lot of passion into training,
so how does it feel?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. One could say
it couldn't feel any more promising.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: To reach heights far beyond my past self... I feel as though I could soar all the way to the heavens.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heyyy! You copied me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
W-What is the meaning of this?!
My press conference is not over yet, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Besides, what good does ascending to heaven do!?
You're gonna bump your head on the top of the gate!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It was a figure of speech!
There is no way I am literally ascending to the heavens!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"To think we'd see a direct showdown
between these two spotlight racers so soon...!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: Man, this is gonna make the Tenno Sho (Spring) crazy exciting!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... Now you've made
things completely awkward.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Because you're copying me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: In any case, the me standing here today is different from who I was before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...I shall surely ascend.
From the 'earth' to the 'heavens'...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: From the “earth”...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the two clash even before the race,
the reporters appeared thoroughly thrilled.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the main event, the "Tenno Sho (Spring),"
is drawing near!
